snippet.title: Portal Foxes TD Trailer
snippet.description:
Defend portals from hordes of slimes with magical foxes in VR.
Build mazes to thwart adaptive enemy pathing in three dimensions.
Unlock 4 fox elements and 4 unique tools over a 20+ level story campaign.
6 DOF cursors and moveable, scaleable game elements for maximum VR comfort.
Coming soon to Steam.
